other_conditions: Only Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs) registered under the Companies Act in Haryana are eligible
FPO must have a minimum of 150 shareholders
FPO must have a financial strength of at least Rs. 10 lakh in its bank account
FPO should have at least 500 acres under horticulture crops (flexible based on project viability)
FPO must have a business plan with backward and forward linkages of its produce
Disputed FPOs or those not meeting the above criteria are ineligible
benefits_summary: Improves access to inputs, services, and markets, increases farmers' income and employment, and enhances horticultural productivity and area.
documents_required: Registration certificate of the FPO under the Companies Act
List of Directors and applicants of the FPO
Business plan with backward and forward linkages of the produce
Financial statements and bank account details of the FPO
Any other documents specified in the application guidelines
